db:select.doc:name: Select Customers
db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, company, status, created_at FROM customers WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY last_name ASC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { count: sizeOf(payload), customers: payload map ((customer) -> { id: customer.customer_id, firstName: customer.first_name, lastName: customer.last_name, email: customer.email, company: customer.company, status: customer.status, createdAt: customer.created_at }) }

db:select.doc:name: Select Customer
db:select.db:sql: SELECT c.*, a.street, a.city, a.state, a.zip_code, a.country FROM customers c LEFT JOIN addresses a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id = :customerId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var cust = payload[0] --- { id: cust.customer_id, firstName: cust.first_name, lastName: cust.last_name, email: cust.email, company: cust.company, status: cust.status, address: { street: cust.street, city: cust.city, state: cust.state, zipCode: cust.zip_code, country: cust.country } }

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: "Customer not found", customerId: vars.customerId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { firstName: payload.firstName, lastName: payload.lastName, email: payload.email, company: payload.company, street: payload.address.street, city: payload.address.city, state: payload.address.state, zipCode: payload.address.zipCode, country: payload.address.country default "US" }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Customer
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customers (first_name, last_name, email, company, status) VALUES (:firstName, :lastName, :email, :company, 'active')
